field_descriptions.arrival_airport: The airport where the flight terminates.
field_descriptions.arrival_gate: Identifier of the flight's arrival gate.
field_descriptions.arrival_terminal: Identifier of the flight's arrival terminal.
field_descriptions.boarding_policy: The type of boarding policy used by the airline (e.g. zone-based or group-based).
field_descriptions.carrier: 'carrier' is an out-dated term indicating the 'provider' for parcel delivery and flights.
field_descriptions.departure_airport: The airport where the flight originates.
field_descriptions.departure_gate: Identifier of the flight's departure gate.
field_descriptions.departure_terminal: Identifier of the flight's departure terminal.
field_descriptions.estimated_flight_duration: The estimated time the flight will take.
field_descriptions.flight_number: The unique identifier for a flight including the airline IATA code. For example, if describing United flight 110, where the IATA code for United is 'UA', the flightNumber is 'UA110'.
field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
field_descriptions.meal_service: Description of the meals that will be provided or available for purchase.
field_descriptions.seller: An entity which offers (sells / leases / lends / loans) the services / goods.  A seller may also be a provider.
field_descriptions.web_checkin_time: The time when a passenger can check into the flight online.
